Bug_Details:
A class can be annotated with at most one scope annotation. Annotating a class with more than one scope annotation is invalid according to
the JSR-330 specification.
Bug_Explanation: The class 'ScopeAnnotationBug' is annotated with both @Singleton and @Named, which violates the JSR-330 specification as a class can have at most one scope annotation.
